name: Dive bar
desc: Deals, drinking, and the conversation nobody wants overheard.
tags: dive bar, long scarred wooden bar counter, row of bar stools, bottles on mirrored back shelves, beer taps, neon beer sign on the wall, dartboard, torn vinyl booth seating, low hanging lamps over a pool table, sticky tabletop, worn floorboards
prose: a dive bar with a scarred wooden counter and a row of stools, bottles ranked on a mirrored back bar, a neon sign burning on the wall and low lamps hung over a battered pool table
note: Seedy and run-down do nothing measurable - wear has to arrive as objects: torn vinyl, a taped stool, the dartboard, a mirror gone cloudy. Left alone the model builds a clean craft cocktail bar with edison bulbs. Darkness is the grade's job (noir, neon, sodium); tagging dark bar leaves the room fully lit, exactly like every other night tag we have measured.
